title: Pakistan Business Compliance Calendar 2026-27
description: A month-by-month guide to the main FBR and SECP dates from November 2026 to October 2027, with notes on extensions and where sources differ.
lead: A month-by-month guide to the main FBR and SECP dates from November 2026 to October 2027, with notes on extensions and where sources differ.
body:
This calendar covers the main federal dates for the 12 months from November 2026. We checked the underlying rules on 3 November 2026. FBR changes dates by notification, and provincial sales tax authorities have their own dates that are not listed here. Always confirm before you rely on a date.

Every month

  • 10th: sales tax Annexure-C.
  • 15th: sales tax payment, and the monthly withholding tax statement.
  • 18th: sales tax return, e-filed.

These apply to the month after the tax period. Special sectors follow special dates.

Income tax

  • 31 December 2026: income tax return for companies with a 30 June year-end (tax year 2026).
  • 30 September 2027: income tax return for individuals and AOPs (tax year 2027).

For tax year 2026, FBR moved the individuals and AOPs date from 30 September to 31 October 2026. Extensions can happen again, so watch for FBR notices.

Advance tax

FBR's calendar shows the 15th of September, December, March and June for individuals and AOPs. In this window that means 15 December 2026, 15 March 2027, 15 June 2027 and 15 September 2027. Sources disagree on company dates, with some giving the 25th, so companies should pay by the earlier date and confirm with their adviser.

SECP: depends on your year-end

These dates move with your financial year and your AGM, so there is no single date. Under the Companies Act, 2017 as described by two law-firm guides:

  • AGM within 120 days of year-end, extendable by up to 30 days. A company with a 31 December 2026 year-end must hold it by 30 April 2027.
  • Annual return within 30 days of the AGM.
  • A copy of the accounts within 15 days of the AGM.
  • Changes in directors or officers reported within 15 days.

Our guide to SECP annual compliance explains each step.

If a date falls on a weekend

Do not assume it moves. Check the FBR notice or file a day early.

Not included

Provincial sales tax on services (PRA, SRB, KPRA, BRA), property and other local taxes, and sector-specific filings. Ask your adviser for your own list.

Get your own dates

Use our free Pakistan Compliance Calendar. Enter your year-end and AGM date and it builds your dates, shows known extensions and exports to Excel or your phone calendar. The FBR Due Dates Calendar covers the tax dates alone. For the basics, read FBR due dates in Pakistan.

Sources: FBR income tax due dates, FBR sales tax due dates, FBR advance tax calendar, Dawn on the 31 October 2026 extension, Legum Law Firm and Lex-Form.
